question: Which alternative mantra forms may be selected in this ritual placement?
premises: Lopā is presented as an option.
Kāmarāja and Trikūṭā are presented as options.
The supreme form is also presented as an option.
inference: The practitioner may choose among Lopā, Kāmarāja, Trikūṭā, or the supreme form.
plain_english: One may use Lopā, or Kāmarāja, or Trikūṭā, or else the supreme form.
